name: experiment
use_for: Trying an idea: hypothesis, result, conclusion.
guide:
Use this when you tried something to learn whether it works.

- **hypothesis**: what you expected and why, in one sentence.
- **setup**: what you changed and what you kept the same.
- **results**: a chart of what happened.
- **numbers**: key numbers from the run.
- **conclusion**: was the hypothesis right? Be honest about weak results.
- **next_step**: what you suggest doing now.

slots.name: setup
slots.label: Setup
slots.hint: What changed, what stayed the same

example.hypothesis: Caching parsed templates will cut render time by half, since parsing is 60% of the profile.
example.setup: Added an LRU cache (256 entries). Same machine, same 1,000 sample pages, 5 runs each.
example.conclusion: Right: render time dropped 55% for a 15% memory increase.
example.next_step: Ship behind a flag and watch memory on the largest tenant.
